description: This file defines the 'Layout' class within the Opencart lock	ype namespace, which extends the base Model class from the Opencart system. It includes methods to retrieve layout information and associated modules from the database, specifically for the Catalog module of OpenCart. The class interacts with database tables related to layout routing and layout modules, indicating its role in managing page layout configurations.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Represents the layout configuration in the catalog module of OpenCart, providing methods to retrieve layout IDs and associated modules based on routes.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a given route from the database.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches the modules assigned to a specific layout and position in the layout.
